about: The operators each column type offers (ADR-0009, ADR-0023), which are the ones the reference implementation accepts. From tests/ExGrid.Tests/AllowedOperatorTests.cs. The C# core's FilterOperators is a static class; the Script Core's query/filter.ts has it as filterOperatorsFor.
subject: FilterOperators

cases.name: ADR-0009 / ADR-0023: text columns offer the text operators
ADR-0009 / ADR-0023: number and date columns offer the ordering operators
ADR-0009 / ADR-0023: boolean columns offer equals, the value list and blankness
ADR-0023: a type nobody declared is refused
